prompt_template: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: high-definition perfume note illustration for ELIXIR. Subject: "{name}". Create one isolated centered square still life with true transparent background, detailed realistic textures and soft studio light. Show the correctly identifiable botanical or food ingredient when this is a real ingredient; for synthetic molecules, imagined accords, metallic, aquatic or abstract descriptors use an elegant abstract material still life, not an invented plant. Sharp premium editorial macro image, subject fills about 80 percent of frame. No text, letters, labels, container, border, collage or watermark. Keep all subject edges inside the frame.
originals: Preserved in the local Codex generated_images directory; not published with the website.

No text, border, label, watermark, container or collage.
